menu.title: The foyer that refuses entry
menu.scene: In a fading sumptuous apartment, the resident braces a gilded console across the inner doorway while fresh crimson impact droplets on cream molding continue from the sealed room onto the parquet; an untouched family breakfast is visible beyond another doorway.

menu.title: The dumbwaiter between family rooms
menu.scene: A resident lowers the brass-edged dumbwaiter shutter in an opulent family dining pantry; crimson splashes burst across its cream interior and patterned apron while a child-free formally laid family table remains visible through the door behind her.

menu.title: The guest left beyond the threshold
menu.scene: A resident at the inner side of a chained apartment door receives a small porcelain key dish through the narrow opening; red impact droplets cross the gilded doorframe and an outside gloved hand remains at the gap.

menu.title: The passage sold as a mirror
menu.scene: In an inherited home, a resident holds open a tall hinged mirror revealing a narrow service passage; directional crimson droplets and a drag trace continue from its dark interior onto the polished floor beside an extravagant decaying flower arrangement.

menu.title: The landing divided by glass
menu.scene: A resident presses a sliding stained-glass partition shut between a lavish stair landing and a kitchen; crimson droplets sprayed on the glass interrupt the bright domestic view while her hand and the partition edge remain connected.

menu.title: The bedroom with a second door
menu.scene: A resident discovered two layers of doors, velvet-padded outer and painted inner; she stops between them with an unturned key while scattered crimson impact droplets on the inner leaf connect to a soiled hem and a recently abandoned room-service tray.
